title: Cardano Smart: A.I. assistant for documentation and on-chain/off-chain development

ms.promise:

ms.report:
Hello reviewers:
・The first proof we have is the video of Cardano Smart working while a side widow tracks resource consumption. In the video, the GPU is the piece of hardware taxed the most by the model. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CDCsEDE2Z1c
・The second video is a demonstration we did for Intersect MBO. They hold a bi-weekly event called Show Us What You Got where projects can showcase their work. We joined for the April 24th one and it was recorded by the host. There Cardano smart is being used live while some people asked questions about it. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vT0qNSiKNYM
・Finally, here is the test version of the Cardano Smart bot. http://cardanosmart.testing.lt:3000/ It is in single-user mode but without reservations. It logs the activity and if it detects that there is an activity from another IP, it locks the bot and says to wait a bit for the other to finish.

So please bear that in mind that if it's locked, likely one of the other testers is using it during that time. Any questions we'll answer via the chat. Happy Labor Day.

ms.promise:
Deploy model in a paid server: the model will be moved from the local setup to a paid server for the first time. 
Optimize the model to work on cloud computing: the model will be optimized to run in the cloud environment.
Deploy and optimize the model on GCP: Transition the AI model from a local environment to the Google Cloud Platform, leveraging Kubernetes for scalable deployment and enhanced performance.
Optimize model for GCP: Enhance for auto-scaling, load balancing, caching, and cost efficiency, ensuring optimal cloud performance.
Implement Cardano documentation scrapers in Python: Use Scrapy for web scraping, detecting changes via content hashing. Automatically processes updates by sending all changed files to the digestion algorithm for inclusion in the vectorial database. Scrapers run bi-daily to keep data current, ensuring all updates are accurately integrated.

Regarding the previous question:
The files that are involved in load balancing and scaling are these:
Load balancing:
gcloud/frontend/service.yaml
gcloud/private-gpt/service.yaml
Vertical scaling:
gcloud/ollama/deployment.yaml
gcloud/doc-scraper/cronjob.yaml
gcloud/private-gpt/deployment.yaml
Other processes like doc-scraping and ingesting are only loaded and at certain times daily and shuts down till the next day. These schedules are set in these files:
gcloud/doc-scraper/cronjob.yaml
gcloud/private-gpt/cronjob.yaml
Also all these deployments and services are hosted on the cluster that is autopilot type, so it automatically manages what size nodes to use and automatically manages horizontal scaling. I created that cluster using Google Cloud Console and there is no code for the creation of this cluster in the project, it was done manually in the GCP interface.
Regards,

ms.promise:
Provide a remote environment for anyone: launch Cardano Smart assistant online. It will be in the form of a website hosted on Google Cloud Platform.
Release the open repository of the project (containing the code, documentation, instructions, and scripts): make the previously closed repository open for anyone to clone. The “Issues GitHub” feature will be used to submit tickets. Pull requests will be used to contribute to the project. For other questions, there will be a dedicated Discord server available to join.
Collect general feedback: collect feedback from the general community. The feedback can be submitted from the website itself and they will be collected into a database. There will be a web-based tool for loading these feedbacks, sorting them by rating, searching to help analyze the data, and marking the valuable parts to better see the insights.
The open beta will be available for 1 month until final release.
ms.criteria:
Online Cardano Smart assistant responds to prompts with answers that are sourced from specific documentation. The outputs will be almost always correct, but to make sure there will be references to sources to check if needed. It is impossible to guarantee that the model will always be 100% correct, they sometimes make mistakes. We expect at least 95% of responses to clear prompts to be correct.
The bot can answer Cardano questions and provide code in examples for PlutusTx, Aiken, Mesh, and Lucid

ms.criteria:
Cardano Smart works on desktop and mobile devices. Speed is about 100 to 200 words per minute. Sometimes slower, sometimes faster, depending on the number of users and complexity of prompts. The expected accuracy is 95%, but it can make mistakes. It should cover such programming languages as Haskell, PlutusTX, and Aiken. It should also be able to provide code using Mesh, and Lucid libraries.
